Select: canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, enzyme_name. Source: metabolism table. Join: compound_records on substrate_record_id to get substrate compound name; molecule_dictionary on molregno to get parent compound name; compound_structures on molregno to get canonical_smiles. Filter: enzyme_name equals 'CYP2D6'. Sort: canonical_smiles ascending, substrate_compound_name ascending, parent_compound_name ascending, met_conversion ascending, pathway_key ascending, organism ascending, enzyme_name ascending. Limit: 200 rows.
